title: Try the weekly voice-note test right away
text: When the weekly voice-note test is switched on and no test has gone out this week yet, the WhatsApp page shows a quiet row with a Send a test now button. Before this you had to wait for Monday to see the first test.
points: Hidden once this week's test exists

steps.name: Open the WhatsApp page
steps.detail: A grey row says the weekly test is on.

steps.name: Press Send a test now
steps.detail: A short spoken test goes to your test phone.

steps.name: Answer Yes or No when it arrives
steps.detail: The card appears about two minutes later.
